main.description: Hands the AppView access to one of the requesting user's personal spaces. The client mints a delegation token on its own PDS for the space and passes it here, because a delegation token is single-use and short-lived and the AppView has no OAuth session of its own. The AppView exchanges the token for a space credential and syncs the space.

space.description: The space to grant access to.

delegationToken.description: A delegation token minted by the user's PDS for the space.

expiresAt.description: When the resulting space credential expires. The client should call this again before then to keep access current.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: InvalidDelegationToken
errors.description: The delegation token is malformed, expired, or already used.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: No space matches the given space reference.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: The delegation token does not grant access to the given space.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The user's PDS failed while the AppView exchanged the delegation token or synced the space.
